items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: She had Jack Skank was booking her. Jack Skank was out of New York. He was out of Brooklyn. He and his son was on the show, you know, managing the show.

ctx.x: I mean the show, though. Was she just with the show, or did she own the show? It was her show. What was her show?

She had Jack Skank was booking her. Jack Skank was out of New York. He was out of Brooklyn. He and his son was on the show, you know, managing the show. Jew. And I tell you, the show went along pretty good for a while, and we had our bad moments too. Nice, I mean ...

What years, can you figure out about what years? You were with Bessie, that would be in 1937, I guess, when she died. Were you with Ida then, you say, in 1940? 1940. 1940. Did you just start with her then?
